name: Jagiellonian University
summary: Kraków university founded in 1364, almost 40,000 students; seven English bachelor's, a Una Europa joint degree, Medicine and Dentistry.

handoff.label: Programmes taught in foreign languages (all levels)

ib.text: No IB points or subjects are set: non-Polish applicants to most English bachelor's are ranked on an online interview in English alone. The IB needs no apostille or translation.

lastYear.text: round 1: 23 February–9 March; round 2 until 11 May

programmes.name: Earth Sciences in a Changing World
programmes.about: Geography, geology and human change to the environment, and how they shape local communities and global change, with lab and field work at the Faculty of Geography and Geology.
programmes.overview: The three-year course gives a grounding in geography, geology and the ways human activity transforms the environment. Classes use the faculty's specialised research laboratories and analytical equipment, plus field activities in Poland and abroad. It was developed with European Social Fund Plus funding. Graduates can identify and describe human-driven environmental change, assess its natural, social and economic effects, and apply environmental management and sustainable development methods, with second-cycle and post-diploma study as next steps.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview in English (100%). It did not run in 2026/27 but is in UJ's 2027/28 admission rules with 40 places for non-Polish citizens.

programmes.name: East European Studies: Languages and Discourses
programmes.about: Eastern Europe's history, cultures, conflicts and discourses, taught in English, with two of Russian, Ukrainian or Polish trained to B2+ and B1+.
programmes.overview: Compulsory courses cover the history of Eastern Europe, basic linguistics, discourse studies and memory studies, together with two Slavic languages chosen from Russian, Ukrainian and Polish, and a broad choice of optional courses. Teaching is entirely in English in small groups, and companies that cooperate with the faculty offer internships. Graduates work in international, governmental and non-governmental organisations, local government, cultural institutions, business, journalism and diplomacy, or continue to a second-cycle degree or the Doctoral School in the Humanities.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 15 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: European Studies
programmes.about: European politics, culture and society through political, sociological and economic lenses; from year two you specialise in Governing Europe and CEE politics or in Social Change in Europe.
programmes.overview: The interdisciplinary core looks at European politics, culture and society through comparative politics, EU governance, human rights law, social change and protest movements, gender politics, digitalisation and environmental movements. Over three years you choose between two specialisations: Governing Europe and Central Eastern European Politics, covering political systems, post-1989 transformations, illiberalism and populism, or Social Change in Europe, covering digitalisation, environmental movements, migration and technological disruption. Language options include Polish, Russian, German and French. Graduates work in public administration, EU and national institutions, NGOs, cultural institutions and media, and the degree leads on to graduate study.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 60 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Global and Development Studies
programmes.about: Globalisation and international development across law, politics, economy, history, society and culture, taught at the Faculty of International and Political Studies.
programmes.overview: The programme brings together law, politics, economics, history, social relations, culture and communication to study globalisation and international development. You can focus on a particular part of the world or on specific global problems. The faculty runs courses under agreements with foreign universities and takes part in Erasmus+, CEEPUS, the Utrecht Network and Una Europa exchanges. Graduates are prepared for public administration, international organisations, NGOs, international companies, cultural institutions, media and publishing, or for master's study such as International Security and Development.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 60 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: International Relations and Area Studies
programmes.about: The global system compared region by region: international relations with area studies, language training and cross-cultural analysis.
programmes.overview: Subjects include international politics and economics, development and global governance, the ethics of international affairs, conflict resolution and peace building, regional integration, and cultural diversity and intercultural dialogue. You specialise in either International Security or Area Studies. The faculty has agreements with foreign universities and takes part in Erasmus+, CEEPUS, the Utrecht Network and Una Europa. Graduates work in government, NGOs, aid and development agencies, business, diplomacy and cultural or regional institutions, or apply for master's programmes in various social sciences.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 60 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Mathematics and Computer Science Advanced Track
programmes.about: A small research-led maths and computer science degree: a personal mentor from year one, tutorials, research projects and a wide choice of courses.
programmes.overview: Mathematics and computer science are studied with an emphasis on theory and research skills, and you have a high degree of freedom in choosing courses. Tutorial-style teaching gives you an individual academic supervisor from the first semester, and you can work on research projects and write scientific papers under a tutor from the first year, alongside laboratory classes in computer labs. Graduates are prepared for research at an international level, going into doctoral programmes, research and development projects or master's study.
programmes.ib: An English interview on maths and computing beyond the school syllabus decides entry; you need 80% of its points and upload proof of your achievements.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the interview alone; under 80% means no place. International olympiad medallists get full marks without it. 15 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Responsible Entrepreneurship and Management
programmes.about: Management and entrepreneurship with a focus on sustainability and the digital economy: start-up culture, data-driven innovation and running organisations internationally, in modules.
programmes.overview: The curriculum centres on management and quality sciences, with entrepreneurship and start-up culture, digital transformation and data-driven innovation, how organisations work in international settings, and the principles of sustainable development. Courses come in coherent modules, the faculty works with the business sector, and double degrees with European universities are possible. Graduates become managers, consultants, digital project leaders and founders of ventures in the private, public and non-profit sectors, or continue to second-cycle study.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 20 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Joint Bachelor in Sustainability
programmes.about: A Una Europa joint degree: year one in Kraków on sustainability basics, then one of six three-semester tracks led by partners such as Helsinki, Paris 1, Madrid or KU Leuven.
programmes.overview: This Una Europa degree starts with introductory and transversal courses in Krakow in the first year, covering the physical basis of climate change, the sustainable development goals, the circular economy and the ethics of sustainability, with language and communication training. In years two and three you choose one of six tracks, each led by a partner university: Sustainable Chemistry and Physics (Helsinki), Economy and Geography (Paris 1 Pantheon-Sorbonne), Law and Politics of Sustainability (Jagiellonian), Environmental and Life Sciences (Complutense Madrid), Economics, Management and Engineering (KU Leuven) and Social Sciences and Humanities (Zurich). An optional final-semester mobility is possible at eight associated universities, and graduates aim for roles such as sustainability consultant, compliance officer or chief sustainability officer.
programmes.ib: Online entrance exam in English; you also need an English certificate such as IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or Cambridge 176.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on an online exam (0-100) on reading texts and data and on set sustainability readings; one list for all citizenships, 180 places in 2027.

programmes.name: Medicine, Program in English
programmes.about: The six-year medical degree of UJ's School of Medicine in English, running since 1994 with students from about twenty countries; taught in Kraków by UJ and visiting faculty.
programmes.overview: The first part covers pre-clinical basic sciences, including a medical Polish course so you can talk with patients, and the second part is clinical, so that by the end of year six you have met all clinical specialties. Teaching combines lectures, laboratory classes, clinical training and placements in health care institutions, and problem-based learning from the second year, with visiting professors from the USA, Canada and Germany. Graduates work in health care, education and research, mostly in Norway, Canada, the UK and the US, and can continue in the Doctoral School in Medical and Health Sciences.
programmes.ib: Online entrance exam in English; IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 87 or C1 Advanced; chemistry plus biology or physics on your certificate.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a 100-question online exam alone. 2026 also took English-medium school or Danish English 7; the 2027 rule lists only certificates, so ask.

programmes.name: Dentistry, Program in English
programmes.about: The five-year dental degree of UJ's School of Medicine in English, taught alongside the English medical programme at the Faculty of Medicine in Kraków.
programmes.overview: Over five years you study basic sciences and clinical dental disciplines, taught entirely in English with information technology. Practical experience comes through the University Dental Clinic, with both theoretical and hands-on dental care, and the faculty includes visiting professors from the USA, Canada and Germany. Graduates work in public and private health care, education and research, and in private dental practice once suitably qualified, and can continue to the Doctoral School in Medical and Health Sciences.
programmes.ib: Online entrance exam in English; IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 87 or C1 Advanced; chemistry plus biology or physics on your certificate.

needs.note: A completed course with a grade on your certificate
A completed course with a grade on your certificate

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the same 100-question online exam as Medicine. 2026 also took English-medium school or Danish English 7; the 2027 rule lists only certificates.

notes: Without Polish citizenship you apply through admission for foreigners, EU citizens included, and pay the programme's fee; only the Joint Bachelor in Sustainability has a lower EU/EEA fee.
Most programmes rank you on an online interview alone, so you can apply before your IB results; you need the diploma in hand by enrolment in September.
The Una Europa Bachelor in European Studies can start in Kraków, but you apply to it through KU Leuven.
